Metadata.title: OFM 2027 — Francophone Mathematical Olympiad · Dakar
Metadata.description: The 2027 Francophone Mathematical Olympiad brings together, online, the best young mathematicians of the French-speaking world, around exams designed by an international scientific committee. Organised by Terangamath (Dakar, Senegal).

Hero.lead: Senegal hosts the organisation of the 2027 edition of the Francophone Mathematical Olympiad, contested online by the best young mathematicians of the French-speaking world.

Olympiad.title: The Francophone Mathematical Olympiad
Olympiad.lead: A competition of excellence for young mathematicians of the French-speaking world, led by the Terangamath association and an international scientific committee.

Presentation.title: A competition of excellence, a spirit of hospitality
Presentation.body1: Each year, OFM brings together the best middle and high school students from French-speaking countries around original mathematics exams, designed to reveal reasoning as much as technique.
Presentation.body2: The 2027 edition is led from Dakar by Terangamath, a Senegalese association dedicated to promoting mathematics, with the ambition of combining scientific rigour with Senegalese hospitality — the Teranga.

Format.title: The exam format
Format.lead: A fully online competition, in the OFM tradition. The details below follow the Olympiad's general rule; Terangamath will confirm them for the 2027 edition.

Organisation.title: Terangamath & the organisation of OFM 2027
Organisation.lead: The Olympiad is led by the Terangamath association, supported by committees dedicated to the scientific design and marking of the exams.

About.title: The organising association
About.body: Terangamath is the Senegalese association behind OFM 2027. Its name draws on the Teranga, Senegalese hospitality, which it puts to work promoting mathematics among young people across the French-speaking world.
